svg.text: How archon tells a person from an agent
It assumes nobody is there unless something says someone is
1. ARCHON_ATTENDANCE says attended or unattended? That answer wins. The Workspaces
2. CI or CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE is true or 1? An agent or a CI job runs this. Unattended
3. Standard input and standard error are both a terminal? A person is typing. Attended
4. Anything else, including output sent through a pipe alone: unattended
Whether ws-host is installed plays no part in the decision
